# montecarlo_self_hosted_file_credentials (Data Source)

File credentials name the file on your deployment that holds a connection's credentials. Monte Carlo stores the path, not the contents.



<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `credentials_id` (String) Id of the credentials, as returned when they are created or listed.

### Read-Only

- `bq_project_id` (String) BigQuery project the connection reads from. Null unless set.
- `connection_type` (String) The connection type the credentials are for, such as `snowflake`. Fixed once created.
- `created_time` (String) When the credentials were created.
- `file_path` (String) Path of the file on the deployment that holds the connection's credentials.
- `id` (String) Unique identifier of the credentials.
- `sql_warehouse_id` (String) Databricks SQL warehouse the connection runs queries on. Null unless set.
- `storage_type` (String) Where the secret lives. Fixed once created.
